dog.description_text:
I'm available for adoption at ACC's Pop-Up Event on:

Saturday, October 24 | 12pm - 4pm
Petco Sheepshead Bay
1610 Ave Y, Brooklyn, NY 11235

Adoptions are in-person and first come, first served, so make sure to get there early. You can apply for me now, but it will not put me on hold for you. I can't wait to meet you!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I have been known to shower my favorite people in love!

I can be slow to adjust to new environments. I prefer to take things at my own pace.

Im a love bug!!
dog.name: Azalea Babee
